correctness.rationale: Direct complete proof: partition all possible {0,1,2}-labelings by hub label 2,1,0. For hub 2, all blade assignments work; for hub 1, precisely all-zero blade choices fail; for hub 0 and m_i>=2, precisely blade weights 0 and 1 fail. Every zero hub is defended since r>=2 and all blades weigh at least 2. The three cases are disjoint and exhaustive, and independent blade choices justify multiplication. Unique weight-2 labeling follows from minimum degrees 2, r+1 and 2r. Independent literal brute-force verification checked every coefficient on 112 instances, enumerating 3,402,756 label assignments. Finite enumeration is supporting evidence, not the proof.

value.rationale: The graph family includes friendship graphs and every homogeneous/heterogeneous single-hub clique bouquet, with arbitrarily many cyclic blades and unequal block sizes. Its complete Italian domination polynomial counts all weights and all functions and yields exact total counts and coefficient data not supplied by the known scalar minimum or tree/cycle algorithms. This is a natural infinite graph-family all-coefficients classification, not an arbitrary finite numerical slice or reformulation of the previously known minimum value. The simple hub-conditioned proof is structural and covers all parameters.
